name: Omarchy Display Workspaces
author: nephilus (based on Omarchy)
description: Per-display workspaces, guarded session layouts, and optional automatic profiles

barWidget.description: The green display highlight follows the cursor. Right-click for compact Displays, Workspaces, and Profiles tabs. Arrange advertised modes, scale, placement, and workspace assignments for enabled outputs through a guarded 20-second Preview. Manual new-connector geometry changes use native output management without writing monitor rules. Resume-aware refresh releases stale native ownership and blocks automation until enabled outputs settle safely. Apply is session-only. Profiles capture confirmed live arrangements; optional automatic restoration requires explicit consent and supported exact rules. Names, icons and order save separately. Forget performs confirmed configuration cleanup with exact backups.
